limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses in vitro polyacrylamide hydrogel substrates to simulate matrix stiffness, which may not fully recapitulate the in vivo tumor microenvironment.
Only breast cancer cell lines (MDA-MB-231, MDA-MB-468, BT-549) were used; results may not generalize to other cancer types.
The study does not include in vivo animal models to validate the findings.
The causal chain from matrix stiffness to drug resistance via ILK and YAP is supported by correlational and inhibitor studies, but direct genetic manipulation (e.g., knockout) was not performed.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
